title: [Day 03] Full DOM snapshot with stable node ids and masking
text:
Part 3 verified.

What I checked:
- CI is green on `15e29e0` (lint, typecheck, test, build) and the Vercel preview deployed.
- Test-first: `test(recorder): resolve URLs, inline styles, support SVG and shadow DOM (#3)` comes before `feat(recorder): resolve URLs, inline styles, support SVG and shadow DOM (#3)`. The implementation commit touches no test file, so no test was removed, skipped or loosened.
- Requirements: a `srcset` with three candidates (relative, root-relative, absolute, with `1x`, `2x`, `400w`) resolves each URL and keeps its descriptor. An open shadow root is a child element marked `isShadowRoot`. A closed shadow root is not recorded.
- Checks: fixture tests cover relative URLs, SVG (including HTML inside `foreignObject`), shadow DOM, same-origin and cross-origin stylesheets.
- Scope: `@rewind/shared` changed to accept `isShadowRoot`. This is needed for `parseEvent`, and ADR 0013 explains it.
- ADR 0013 and 0014 exist and `docs/decisions/README.md` lists them. `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` is updated.
- Commits are authored as the owner with the Cursor Agent co-author trailer.

Notes for later, not blocking this part:
- `srcset` is split on every comma, so a `data:` URL candidate (which contains a comma) would be split wrongly.
- Inlined CSS keeps relative `url(...)` values as written, so fonts and background images in same-origin CSS may not load on replay.

Next: Part 4.
